# netbox_cooling_outflow_templates (Data Source)

Lists NetBox cooling outflow template objects (`/api/dcim/cooling-outflow-templates/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_cooling_outflow_templates" "all" {}

data "netbox_cooling_outflow_templates" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "cooling_outflow_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_cooling_outflow_templates.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/cooling-outflow-templates/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name; validated against the parameters of the endpoint.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cooling_intake_id` (Number) ID of the Cooling Intake Template (`netbox_cooling_intake_template`).
- `created` (String) Created.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `diameter` (Number) Diameter. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `diameter_unit` (String) Diameter Unit. Valid values: `mm`, `cm`, `in`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `module_type_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type (`netbox_module_type`).
- `name` (String) {module} is accepted as a substitution for the module bay position when attached to a module type.
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `uqd`, `uqdb`, `qdc`, `camlock`, `npt`, `bsp`, `proprietary`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
